body.name: \(P_{\rho}\)
body.construction: Using \(s^0_{gt}=\sqrt{\tau_0m_{gt}}\), put \(Y_g=m_g+s_g^0\odot\varepsilon_g\); for finite \(g\), assign \(\Pr_{\rho}(\varepsilon_g=e)=2^{-T}[1+\sum_{t=2}^{g-1}\rho_{gt}e_te_g]\) under \(\sum_{t=2}^{g-1}|\rho_{gt}|<1\), retain independent Rademacher coordinates for \(g=\infty\), and set \(x_{gt}=s^0_{gt}s^0_{gg}\rho_{gt}\). Complete the potential outcomes by \(Y_{gt}(0)=Y_{gt}(1)=Y_{gt}\) on \(U\), \(Y_{gt}(1)=Y_{gt}\) on \(D\), and \(Y_{gt}(0)=\mu_{gt}\) on \(D\)
